title: Introduce ItemStore class in Flask app
description: Brownfield Python/Flask refactor: extract item management into an ItemStore class and update routes to use it.

task_spec.prompt:
Refactor src/app.py to introduce an ItemStore class. All 2 existing tests must still pass.

Add a class ItemStore with:
  def all(self) -> list[dict]
    — returns all items
  def add(self, name: str, price: float) -> dict
    — creates a new item with auto-incremented id, appends to internal list, returns the item
  def find(self, item_id: int) -> dict | None
    — returns item with matching id, or None if not found
  def reset(self) -> None
    — resets items to the original two fixture items and resets the id counter

Create a module-level instance: _store = ItemStore()
Update GET /api/items to call _store.all() instead of returning _items directly.
Update GET / to pass _store.all() to the template.
The GET / and GET /api/items routes must behave identically to before.
Do not add new routes.
All 2 existing tests must still pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: ItemStore class with all(), add(), find(), reset() methods
success_criteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
